items.text: YOU FIND ASSORTED REPORTS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FIND HARD EVIDENCE THAT CADORNA HAS BEEN USING YOU FOR HIS OWN ENDS AND HAS BEEN SEEKING THE POOL OF RADIANCE FOR HIMSELF.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FIND A REPORT INDICATING THAT THE NORTHERN BARBARIANS ARE READY FOR THE TAKE OVER OF A STRONG LEADER AND THAT THE CHIEF OF THE RAVEN CLAN IS ALLIED TO TYRANTHRAXUS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FIND EVIDENCE THAT THE RED WIZARDS OF THAY ARE ALLIED TO TYRANTHRAXUS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: TO FIND ANYTHING MORE YOU WILL HAVE TO SPEND SO MUCH TIME THAT YOU WILL NEED TO CLEAR THE AREA FIRST.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A SCRIBE WALKS INTO THE ROOM. HE SEES YOU AND LETS OUT A GASP. HE DROPS HIS BOOKS AND RUNS OUT THE DOOR.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS HE COMES THROUGH THE DOOR YOU KNOCK HIM OUT AND DRAG HIS FORM INTO A CORNER.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS HE COMES THROUGH THE DOOR YOU SLIT HIS THROAT. THE BODY IS DRAGGED INTO A CORNER.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AN ALARM IS SOUNDING.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: AN ALARM STARTS RINGING!
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: DO YOU TAKE IT?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: THERE IS A HEDGE WITH POISONOUS THORNS IN THAT DIRECTION. DO YOU WANT TO TRY TO CUT THROUGH?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: AS YOU SLICE THROUGH SOMEONE IS PRICKED BY A THORN.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU FEEL A SUDDEN DISORIENTATION.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: THREE GIANTS STEP UP TO YOU.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU SURPRISE THREE GIANTS!
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: 'ALL RIGHT, THEN. WHAT TODAY'S PASSWORD?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WRONG! GUESS AGAIN!
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WRONG! THERE IS NO PASSWORD! HA! HA! HA!' THE GIANTS ATTACK.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'OH, YEAH? WHO SEND YOU?'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'OH, WE SORRY! JUST DOING JOB! PLEASE NO TELL? WE LET YOU... WE STAY AT POST. MAKE SURE NO ONE GO BY!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WHO HIM? OH WELL HE NO CAN HELP YOU NOW!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU HAVE ENTERED THE REMAINS OF A TOWER.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: A PACK OF TROLLS CHARGE FROM WHERE THEY WERE HIDING.
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: YOU HEAR A DEEP VOICE, 'HEY, THAT'S THEM GUYS WHO TRIED TO BUST IN!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: YOU HEAR A DEEP VOICE, 'THIEF! YOU STOLE FROM LORD BANE!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: A VOLLEY OF BOULDERS ARE THROWN AT YOU...
items.direction: Urgent dramatic fantasy narration with clear danger and action

items.text: WHAT PASSWORD DO YOU GIVE?
items.direction: Clear measured fantasy narration ending with a direct question

items.text: 'ALL RIGHT, THEN. PASS!' AND WITH THAT THE GATES SWING OPEN AND YOU PASS THROUGH THE GATE.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'HAH! HAH! YOU'RE DUMB! THAT'S NOT THE PASSWORD!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WAIT! I WAS JUST A MAGE SEARCHING FOR KNOWLEDGE WHEN TYRANTHRAXUS CAPTURED ME. I'VE BEEN FORCED TO WORK FOR HIM. SPARE ME AND I WILL LEAVE, NEVER TO RETURN!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'WAIT! PLEASE! I'LL GIVE YOU ALL MY NOTES! HERE THEY ARE!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: HE SCRAMBLES OUT THE DOOR.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: HE QUICKLY LEAVES. YOU ARE LEFT WITH THE NOTES OF AL-HYAM DHAZID, WHICH TELL QUITE A LOT ABOUT THE POOL OF RADIANCE. YOU COPY THEM INTO YOUR JOURNAL AS ENTRY 30.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: YOU GO UPSTAIRS.
items.direction: Measured expressive fantasy narration appropriate to the scene

items.text: AS YOU QUICKLY LEAVE THE ROOM, YOU HEAR ONE OF THE GIANTS SAY, 'AH, US RIGHT. THEM JUST AFRAID TO SAY 'CAUSE KNOW YOU SMASH 'EM.' THE ARGUMENT RESUMES.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: AS THE OTHER GIANTS BURST INTO HOWLS OF LAUGHTER THE ONE WHO TALKED TO YOU TURNS RED AND SAYS, 'YOU LIE! YOU LIE TO MAKE ME FOOL! I SMASH YOU!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: BEFORE HE CAN ATTACK THE OTHERS GRAB HIM AND SAY, 'YOU BETTER GO LITTLE MEN.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: AS THE GIANT TURNS IN TRIUMPH TO HIS COMPANIONS, THE OTHERS PICK UP THEIR CLUBS. 'WHAT THEY KNOW? WE KNOCK DUMB LITTLE MEN'S BRAINS OUT!'
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech

items.text: 'YOU NO HURT THEM. THEM MY BUDDIES!' THEY ARGUE FOR A LITTLE BIT AND THEN ONE SAYS, 'HEY, WHAT WE FIGHTING FOR? IT'S ALL FAULT OF THEM!' 'YEH!' THEY TURN AND ATTACK YOU.
items.direction: Expressive fantasy narration with a clear same-narrator character performance for quoted speech
